brief: Priority 1: enter at (29.68343, -90.09864), closest to 38 isolated buildings [F3]. Priority 2: enter at (29.67948, -90.10179), closest to 26 isolated buildings [F4]. Priority 3: enter at (29.68418, -90.09832), closest to 11 isolated buildings [F5]. Priority 4: enter at (29.68510, -90.09806), closest to 4 isolated buildings [F6]. Buildings are 87 isolated, 0 uncertain, 0 reachable, 2 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. 89 road pieces were checked: 77 judged flooded, 9 uncertain, and rest judged dry [F1]. Flood judgements are from satellite photos via vision model, not field-verified; uncertain roads need drone or ground check [F8]. Testing 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles marked 1 of 666 cut-off buildings reachable, with 'isolated' right roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most could get out and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off; treat as check not confirmed [F7].

facts.F1: 89 road pieces were checked: 77 judged flooded, 9 uncertain, the rest judged dry.
facts.F2: Buildings: 87 isolated (cut off from every exit road), 0 uncertain, 0 still reachable, 2 with no mapped road nearby.

facts.F7: In testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles, 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable. How often an 'isolated' call was right depended on the area: roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out, and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off. Treat 'isolated' as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off.
facts.F8: Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos and are not field-verified; uncertain roads need a drone or ground check.
